title: unified-rollouts: canary / A/B / shadow autorollback workflow and safety guards
author: Priya Natarajan
body:
Summary: Adds a unified autorollback workflow that coordinates canary, A/B, and shadow rollouts with multi-metric safety guards, quarantine stage, and observability hooks. Motivation: customers running production inference need predictable, automatic rollback behavior for model rollouts to reduce incident MTTR and avoid prolonged quality regressions. This PR implements the orchestration layer and runtime hooks to trigger safe, measurable rollbacks based on configurable metric quorums and staged probing.

Design and changes: 1) Autorollback engine: new rollout engine module that evaluates composite metrics (latency p95, error-rate, output-quality drift) against per-stage thresholds and metric quorum rules. Supports immediate rollback, quarantine (pause + isolate traffic), and staged rollback for weighted canaries. 2) Shadow probing: introduce a probing stage for shadow traffic with active probing requests and automated scoring; failures increase quarantine weight and can trigger rollback if quorum is reached. 3) A/B integration: extend the traffic router to accept A/B variants and to run metric comparisons with adjusted significance windows. 4) Observability: metrics, traces and events emitted for each decision with rollout_id and probe_id tags; added dashboards and alert rules. 5) Safety guards: rate-limited rollback actions, cooldown windows, and a manual-confirm override. 6) CLI and API: new rolloutctl subcommands and API endpoints to create/inspect workflows.

Testing: unit tests for rollback decision logic, integration tests for router behavior, e2e scenario tests that simulate regression and verify automated rollback path. Load tests of canary weighting logic to ensure no thundering herd when shifting traffic.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked - [x] Implementation of autorollback engine - [x] Router integration for canary / A/B / shadow - [x] Observability hooks and dashboards - [x] e2e + integration tests - [x] Docs and runbook updates - [x] Migration notes for rollout config schema

Notes: CI had a flaky e2e on first run (timeout in probe test); reran and all checks passed. This PR includes small schema migration that is backwards compatible (v1->v2 additions) and a one-time migration step is included in rolloutctl. Related: ENG-2052 (autorollback policy), ENG-2078 (observability for rollouts). For operational details see docs: redwood/docs/unified-rollouts.md.

Merge: squash merge into main after final approvals.
commits: feat(rollouts): add autorollback engine with metric-quorum evaluation
feat(router): integrate A/B and weighted canary routing hooks
feat(shadow): add active probing and shadow probe scorer
perf(batch): ensure rollout transitions are rate-limited to avoid spikes
test(e2e): add regression scenario and autorollback verification
docs: update unified-rollouts.md and runbook with workflow examples
files_changed: redwood/pkg/rollouts/engine.go - autorollback decision engine and policies
redwood/pkg/router/router.go - traffic routing hooks for canary/A-B/shadow
redwood/pkg/shadow/prober.go - shadow active probing and scoring
redwood/pkg/rollouts/migration.go - migration helper for v1->v2 configs
redwood/ci/flake-guards.yml - extended timeout for probe e2e
redwood/README.md - high-level mention of unified rollouts
review_comments:
Ben Clarke: Strong design. Two requests: (1) make the cooldown configurable per-customer; (2) ensure rollback actions are idempotent across controller restarts.
Priya: Addressed both; cooldown added to policy config with sensible defaults, and rollback operations now record a reconciliation marker to avoid double-apply.
Maya Li: Observability looks good; can you add a note about cardinality cost for rollout_id tag?
Priya: Yes - scoped rollout_id to 'short_id' in emitted metrics and added dashboard panel that uses aggregated tags.
Arjun Patel: Request small refactor around router weight transition to avoid lock contention.
Priya: Refactored weighting logic and added a unit test.
Approvals: Ben Clarke approved; Maya Li approved after follow-ups; Arjun approved. CI: initial e2e timeout, rerun succeeded.
release_notes: Automated rollout autorollback workflow: canary, A/B, and shadow rollouts now support configurable multi-metric autorollback with quarantine stage and observability hooks. Includes CLI/API for inspection and migration helper for rollout configs.
additional_notes: Operators should review new alert rules and ensure dashboards are provisioned in staging before production rollout. The migration helper will no-op if v2 fields already present.
changelog_entry: Added autorollback workflow (canary/A-B/shadow) with safety guards, observability, and migration tooling.
